turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is your PayLite training coach. We'll do a quick five-question check on the Soundbox. Ready?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First question. What does the Soundbox cost the merchant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ninety-nine rupees mahina rent hai. Aur... pehla mahina free hai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question two. Which payment types does it support?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question three. What documents does a merchant need to sign up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: PAN card, bank account ki details, aur... shop ki photo. Haan, shop ki photo. GST zaroori nahi hai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question four. A merchant says, 'I already have a free QR sticker, why should I pay for a Soundbox?' How do you respond?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Main bolunga, bhaiya, QR sticker mein awaaz nahi aati. Koi bhi fake screenshot dikha ke chala jayega. Soundbox har payment bol ke batata hai, aapki bhasha mein bhi. Aur pasand nahi aaya to tees din mein wapas kar sakte ho.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. When does the merchant get the money in their bank account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Turant aata hai. Same time, instant.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Check khatam, Ravi. Feedback message pe aa jayega.
